# BulkLoads

> > BulkLoads is a specialized freight load board connecting carriers with grain, feed ingredients, fertilizer, and bulk commodity shipments across the United States.

The platform focuses on bulk hauling opportunities across multiple trailer types including end dumps, hoppers, tankers, belt trailers, and walking floors. BulkLoads serves key agricultural and industrial regions including Kansas, Indiana, Louisiana, Ohio, Nebraska, and Pennsylvania with freight matching tools and rate calculators for bulk transport operations.

## Key Topics

- Bulk freight load board
- Grain and feed ingredient hauling
- Fertilizer transportation
- End dump trailers
- Hopper trailers
- Tanker loads (liquid & chemical)
- Walking floor trailers
- Belt trailers
- Kansas freight market
- Indiana freight market
- Louisiana freight market
- Ohio freight market
- Trucking rate calculator
- Agricultural commodity transport
- Bulk hauling operations
